name: @wtf/pasta-suite-desktop
description: Native Pasta Protocol suite installer builds for Mac, Windows, and Raspberry Pi.

scripts.pack: npm run prepare && node ../../scripts/pasta-desktop-build-provenance.mjs --mode=preflight --format=directory --output=provenance/build-provenance.json && electron-builder --dir --publish never
scripts.dist: npm run prepare && node ../../scripts/pasta-desktop-build-provenance.mjs --mode=release --format=platform-default --output=provenance/build-provenance.json && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run prepare && node ../../scripts/pasta-desktop-build-provenance.mjs --mode=release --platform=darwin --arch=universal --format=dmg+zip --output=provenance/build-provenance.json && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --universal --publish never
scripts.dist:alpha:mac: npm run prepare && node ../../scripts/pasta-desktop-build-provenance.mjs --mode=preflight --platform=darwin --arch=universal --format=dmg+zip --output=provenance/build-provenance.json && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --universal --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:dir: npm run prepare && node ../../scripts/pasta-desktop-build-provenance.mjs --mode=preflight --platform=darwin --arch=universal --format=directory --output=provenance/build-provenance.json && electron-builder --mac dir --universal --publish never
scripts.dist:windows: npm run prepare && node ../../scripts/pasta-desktop-build-provenance.mjs --mode=release --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --format=nsis --output=provenance/build-provenance.json && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:raspberry-pi: npm run prepare && node ../../scripts/pasta-desktop-build-provenance.mjs --mode=release --platform=linux --arch=arm64 --format=deb --output=provenance/build-provenance.json && electron-builder --linux deb --arm64 --publish never
